items.title: AI agents hit 9 in 10 Indian firms in past 1 year, only 36% dealt with it in 24hrs
items.author: PRANJAL PANDEY
items.description: In a recent survey, an alarming 92% of Indian organizations reported security incidents involving AI agents. A mere 36% were able to resolve these incidents within 24 hours, exposing governance weaknesses. While 51% had automated systems to detect unusual behavior, 67% lacked automatic response capabilities. Moreover, 37% found unregistered AI agents in their systems in the past year.
